physicalNotes: Radius 0.9603 +/- 0.0175 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HIP 8152 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 668,081 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
